crossRefs.note: Or don’t you know that the unrighteous will not inherit God’s Kingdom? Don’t be deceived. Neither the sexually immoral…
Jesus answered them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.
Many false prophets will arise, and will lead many astray.
For there will arise false christs, and false prophets, and they will show great signs and wonders, so as to lead…
Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.
Let no one deceive you with empty words. For because of these things, the wrath of God comes on the children of…
and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn’t receive the love of the truth…
The great dragon was thrown down, the old serpent, he who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole…
All who dwell on the earth will worship him, everyone whose name has not been written from the foundation of the world…
Your boasting is not good. Don’t you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump?
Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”
One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,
looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up…
Many will follow their immoral ways, and as a result, the way of the truth will be maligned.
For, uttering great swelling words of emptiness, they entice in the lusts of the flesh, by licentiousness, those who…
